The '''AeroChaser speeder bike''' was a model produced by [[Lhosan Industries]]. The speedy bike was designed and manufactured on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and popular throughout the galaxy due to its high velocity, durability, and large number produced. One variant was the [[XT-model bike|XT-Model Bike]].

The single-seat bike was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] military during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] due to its ability to outrun [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]]. The military discontinued their use of the vehicle during the [[Jedi Civil War]], but the model continued to be popular with civilians, particularly outlaws, especially because of its ease for modifications.
